thesis: Machine-proposed candidate (app.evolution). Tests a 8/32-day EMA crossover trigger inside a 110-day SMA regime filter on AAPL, ADBE, INTU, LRCX, CSCO, KLAC, AMAT, CRM, VUG, IGV, with a 10% stop and a 119-session time stop. Never scored before being written -- this is falsified if the crossover-inside-regime signal fails to beat this purpose's benchmark by more than the measured ordering-noise floor, across whatever windows it is actually run against.
entry: close > sma(110) and ema(8) crosses_above ema(32)
